hypothesis: At fixed inputs, parameter count and optimizer settings, additional direct CX interactions may improve maize-wheat separation; they may also harm stability or increase cost.

fixed.features: original StandardScaler -> PCA(4, full SVD) -> StandardScaler
fixed.class_readout: basis outcome modulo 3; alfalfa, maize, wheat; group sizes 6/5/5
fixed.initialization: default_rng(seed).uniform(-pi,pi,12), exactly identical across topologies per seed
fixed.training_engine: inherited verified native Qiskit Statevector/Operator cache; no custom gate simulator

selection.folds: reuse previous Model D 3-fold stratified assignments, random_state=2026
selection.criterion: mean of three seed-specific pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 scores
selection.tie_break: fewer CX gates, then listed topology order
selection.limitation: Training spatial grouping is unavailable; folds are not spatial.

evaluation: Lock training-only selection before scoring the predefined candidates on validation, then refit all topologies on all 914 fields for seeds 0/1/2.
budget_disclosure: Every gradient costs 24 shifted plus one unshifted probability pass. Actual evaluation counts, convergence, CX count, depth and runtime can differ by topology.
